RADI 702.description: Each resident is encouraged to complete an investigative project in each of the four years in Radiology, under the supervision of a faculty member, for possible presentation at an annual department meeting. Average 80 hours each year. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

RADI 710.description: Daily discussions of the clinical applications of nuclear medicine. See PATH 730. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

RADI 711.description: Weekly reviews of current literature topics in nuclear medicine. See PATH 731. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

RADI 712.description: Participation in ongoing research projects within the division. See PATH 732. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

RADI 713.description: Review of diagnostic nuclear medicine procedure, correlation with other diagnostic tests, and final patient diagnosis. Also offered as PATH 733. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
